security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: asset: http://asset.localhost; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'none'

bundle.shortDescription: Monitor Bambu Lab 3D printers from the menu bar.
bundle.longDescription: PandaSpy watches Bambu Lab 3D printers on your local network and shows print progress, temperatures and errors from the menu bar, without a cloud round-trip.
